name: CUDA Voxelizer GPU Voxelization
aliases: CUDA Voxelizer GPU Voxelization — Implementation Details
Fast parallel surface and solid voxelization on GPUs
definition: A GPU-accelerated method to convert polygon meshes into voxel grids using CUDA. It supports both surface voxelization (faces) and solid voxelization (filled volume).
summary: CUDA Voxelizer is a GPU-accelerated method converting polygon meshes to voxel grids using bit-packed tables and conservative rasterization to mitigate atomic contention.
